name: MalarAI
summary: An offline Android app that screens blood-smear images for malaria parasites, built for clinics with no reliable internet. EfficientNet-B0 with Grad-CAM explanations, converted to TensorFlow Lite to run on-device.
points: Runs fully offline on an Android phone
Shows a Grad-CAM heatmap for every prediction
Designed for clinics in low-resource settings

name: Skill Bank
summary: A searchable library of 772 AI agent skill repositories. I used Spidra Map to discover candidate repos, cleaned, deduplicated and verified them, then shipped a static React site with in-browser fuzzy search. Built with Meeday.

name: WhatsApp health chatbot
summary: A health-information chatbot that answers on WhatsApp, using Twilio's WhatsApp API for messaging and Google Gemini for responses. Built end to end, then written up as a step-by-step guide.
